title: Resolve merge conflicts for #2575 (merge main into claude/github-issue-2358-3b099c)
body:
Merges `origin/main` into #2575's head branch and resolves the conflicts. Merging this PR makes #2575 mergeable again.

## Conflicts and resolutions

Both conflicts came from #2361 landing on main (metadata-driven `maxVisible` / `action:menu` inline-overflow split for `page:header`), which rewrote the same split logic that #2575 extended with `record_more` routing (#2358 trap 2):

- **`packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`** — kept main's #2361 split (`maxVisible` / `mobileMaxVisible` overrides, `component: 'action:menu'` pinning, pre-sorted inline slots) and layered #2575's rule on top: actions declaring **only** `record_more` (not `record_header`) are always routed into the `⋯` overflow menu and never claim an inline slot, regardless of count. Overflow order is: past-`maxVisible` buttonables, then `action:menu`-pinned, then `record_more`-only.
- **`packages/components/src/__tests__/page-header-actions.test.tsx`** — both sides appended a new `describe` block at the same spot; kept both (the #2358 trap suite and the #2361 split suite).

Two pre-#2361 assumptions in existing tests were reconciled by the merge itself (`RecordDetailView.tsx`, `ActionRunner.test.ts` auto-merged cleanly).

## Verification

- `page-header-actions.test.tsx`: 28/28 pass (covers both suites).
- `ActionRunner.test.ts` + `ActionEngine.visibility.test.ts` + `useExpression.test.ts`: 96/96 pass.
- `packages/components` `tsc --noEmit`: clean.
